evidence: Runtime AX: ⌘, opened com_apple_SwiftUI_Settings_window containing no controls; ThinkAloud/App/ThinkAloudApp.swift
pre_fix_conclusion: The standard Settings shortcut opens a blank window instead of the real Settings UI.
required_remediation: Route the app-menu Settings command and ⌘, to the single AppKit Settings window.

evidence: Fresh isolated bundle runtime: Sparkle SUUpdateAlert appeared before first-run onboarding; UpdaterController.swift startingUpdater true
pre_fix_conclusion: A scheduled update interrupts first-run setup before the product is introduced.
required_remediation: Start scheduled checks only after onboarding is completed; manual checks must remain available.

evidence: TutorialStep.swift reads only startRecording and repeats it for stop/insert although ShortcutsPane exposes three independent bindings
pre_fix_conclusion: Changing the onboarding shortcut can make the next two instructions false.
required_remediation: Teach the three actual phase shortcuts while keeping shortcut editing centralized in Settings.

evidence: PopupStateViews.swift: Insert now calls insertAndSave; review state separates Insert from Insert & Save
pre_fix_conclusion: A label hides a persistent recording/dataset side effect.
required_remediation: Make every action label exactly match insertion and storage side effects.

evidence: PopupCoordinator.swift closes/reset popup before dataset save and logs save failure only
pre_fix_conclusion: Insert & Save can fail silently after the UI has claimed completion.
required_remediation: Keep or restore recoverable state and expose a retryable save error.

evidence: ModelDownloadList.swift selects a model with onTapGesture on a non-focusable row
pre_fix_conclusion: Keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot reliably switch the main ASR model.
required_remediation: Use a native selection control or a focusable semantic button with selected state.

evidence: OnboardingWindowController.swift marks onboarding completed on every window close
pre_fix_conclusion: An accidental close is persisted as explicit completion.
required_remediation: Persist completion only after Finish or explicit Skip.

evidence: Preparing view has no Cancel; popup hides window buttons and windowShouldClose returns false
pre_fix_conclusion: The user has no visible escape from a stalled start operation.
required_remediation: Provide Cancel/Escape and cancel the pending start task.

evidence: All PopupPhase.error strings show the same Permissions link; several errors use String(describing:)
pre_fix_conclusion: Recovery actions are unrelated to many model/recorder/transcription failures.
required_remediation: Use typed failures with Retry or the correct Settings destination and user-facing copy.

evidence: MenuBarController builds a fixed mic icon and Start recording item once; invoke is a no-op in later phases
pre_fix_conclusion: The persistent status item neither reports nor controls the active phase.
required_remediation: Observe phase and update icon, accessibility title, menu command, and enabled state.

evidence: AchievementService swallows statistics errors with try?; Insights remains in loading forever
pre_fix_conclusion: A failure is falsely presented as continuing work.
required_remediation: Model loading/success/empty/failure explicitly and provide Retry.

evidence: Refine model download/remove uses try? and renders no failure
pre_fix_conclusion: Multi-gigabyte operations can fail with no explanation or recovery.
required_remediation: Expose per-model operation errors and retry; never imply removal succeeded on failure.

evidence: Long model downloads, smoke test, and denoise processing have no explicit cancellation path
pre_fix_conclusion: Resource-intensive work cannot be stopped from the interface.
required_remediation: Wire real task cancellation where supported and clearly identify genuinely non-cancellable stages.

evidence: Per-app override minus button immediately deletes prompt/config with no undo or confirmation
pre_fix_conclusion: A small icon can irreversibly remove substantial custom input.
required_remediation: Provide Undo or a named confirmation before removal.

evidence: Denoise tester opens System Settings but does not refresh permission on app activation
pre_fix_conclusion: The recovery path can remain stale after access is granted.
required_remediation: Share permission lifecycle refresh or observe activation in the tester.

evidence: Dictionary rows use Toggle("") and placeholder-only TextFields with no row-specific AX names
pre_fix_conclusion: VoiceOver cannot reliably identify or edit replacement controls.
required_remediation: Provide a semantic row group and persistent row-specific labels, values, hints, and remove action.

evidence: Runtime AX omitted the progress capsules and announced every downloaded model row as selected
pre_fix_conclusion: Onboarding orientation and selection semantics are false or missing for VoiceOver.
required_remediation: Expose step n of total and exactly one semantic selected model; hide decorative status symbols.

evidence: ModelDownloadList uses a fixed 5 GB threshold and maps capacity lookup failure to zero
pre_fix_conclusion: The low-disk warning is not trustworthy for the selected model.
required_remediation: Use model-specific required space plus safety margin; represent unknown capacity honestly.

evidence: Relaunch callback ignores open result/error and always terminates current instance
pre_fix_conclusion: A failed relaunch becomes an unexplained quit.
required_remediation: Terminate only after successful relaunch; retain the current app and show an error otherwise.

evidence: ASR Load/Unload has no visible runtime status or ModelManager.lastError
pre_fix_conclusion: The diagnostics pane cannot diagnose its main model operation.
required_remediation: Show live ASR status, failure, Retry, and Model deep link.

evidence: Finish always shows a green success mark and You're all set while required microphone/model items may remain
pre_fix_conclusion: The completion claim contradicts actual readiness.
required_remediation: Use success only when ready; otherwise show a truthful incomplete summary and required/optional distinction.

evidence: Header says the app needs two permissions while Accessibility is explicitly optional
pre_fix_conclusion: Permission rationale overstates access requirements.
required_remediation: State that microphone is required and Accessibility is an optional paste enhancement.

evidence: SettingsRouter defaults to Insights after every close and does not persist last category
pre_fix_conclusion: Returning users repeatedly navigate back to their working pane.
required_remediation: Restore the last pane while preserving explicit Insights deep links.

evidence: Custom move transitions and repeating effects do not consult accessibilityReduceMotion
pre_fix_conclusion: The app ignores a platform motion preference.
required_remediation: Use static/fade alternatives and stop nonessential repetition when Reduce Motion is enabled.

evidence: The only rerun Setup Assistant command is buried in Advanced; status menu has no Help/setup entry
pre_fix_conclusion: Core interaction help is hard to rediscover.
required_remediation: Keep contextual shortcut help in Settings and the Setup Assistant discoverable in Advanced without duplicating them in the primary status menu.

evidence: Buttons that open System Settings, sheets, or another window inconsistently omit ellipses
pre_fix_conclusion: The UI does not consistently signal that another interaction stage follows.
required_remediation: Apply macOS ellipsis conventions consistently.

evidence: DatasetPane clear-all deletes only DB rows; browser ignores audio deletion failure
pre_fix_conclusion: The UI promises deletion while sensitive recordings can remain orphaned and untraceable.
required_remediation: Make record and audio deletion a verified operation with precise partial-failure recovery.

evidence: create repo treats HTTP 409 as success and never verifies/updates existing repository visibility
pre_fix_conclusion: Private can upload into an existing public repository.
required_remediation: Verify and enforce repository visibility before any commit; abort if it cannot match consent.

evidence: Changing selection/mode or closing the window resets an unsaved draft without warning
pre_fix_conclusion: Manual transcript edits can be lost silently.
required_remediation: Guard dirty transitions with Save/Discard/Cancel or reliable autosave/undo.

evidence: Save exits edit mode before await; controller error is never rendered
pre_fix_conclusion: A failed save looks successful and loses the retry context.
required_remediation: Keep the draft/editor through saving and failure; exit only on success.

evidence: Browser load/delete errorMessage has no UI consumer; load failure appears as empty
pre_fix_conclusion: Loading and partial deletion failures are invisible or misclassified.
required_remediation: Separate loading/empty/error and show retry plus exact partial-delete results.

evidence: Run can start a 0.5–3 GB model download with no cost notice and shows Running 0/0 during preload
pre_fix_conclusion: A benchmark can consume major resources without informed consent or useful status.
required_remediation: Show local/download/size state before Run and model download/preload stages with cancellation.

evidence: When history exists the view renders old reports before a new run error/cancel message
pre_fix_conclusion: A failed new run can be mistaken for a successful old result.
required_remediation: Keep history but surface the failed run and retry context above it.

evidence: Missing audio is silently skipped while metadata still references its path
pre_fix_conclusion: Push complete can produce an internally broken external dataset.
required_remediation: Preflight every included audio file and block or explicitly reconcile exclusions before commit.

evidence: recordCount starts at zero and renders No records before asynchronous count completes
pre_fix_conclusion: Existing data briefly appears lost.
required_remediation: Use explicit idle/loading/loaded/error state.

evidence: Dataset Export JSONL writes to a hidden fixed folder while benchmark export opens NSSavePanel
pre_fix_conclusion: Equivalent Export actions have different and surprising behavior.
required_remediation: Use the standard save panel for user exports; name automatic backups separately if needed.

evidence: Benchmark export catch only logs the failure
pre_fix_conclusion: Export can fail with no visible result or retry.
required_remediation: Show a localized actionable write error and preserve retry context.

evidence: Configuration controls stay editable during a run although the controller uses a start-time snapshot
pre_fix_conclusion: Visible settings can contradict the active run.
required_remediation: Lock configuration or separate current-run and next-run configuration explicitly.

evidence: History label contains minute-level time and model only, omitting preprocessing/output config
pre_fix_conclusion: Runs can have indistinguishable names and require recall.
required_remediation: Create unique labels with precise time and distinguishing configuration.

evidence: Paged fixed-width record list has no search/filter and cannot resize
pre_fix_conclusion: Large datasets are inefficient to navigate and less adaptable to content size.
required_remediation: Add keyboard-focusable database-backed search and preserve a stable content-prioritized sidebar proportion.

evidence: Empty states hard-code ⌥Space although all three shortcuts are user-configurable
pre_fix_conclusion: Guidance can teach an inactive shortcut.
required_remediation: Read the actual start shortcut and deep-link to Shortcuts when unset.

evidence: Audio prepare/play errors are logged only and Play can remain apparently actionable
pre_fix_conclusion: A broken or missing recording looks like an unresponsive control.
required_remediation: Expose loading/ready/error and disable controls with a recovery explanation.

evidence: Icon-only Play/Pause and unlabeled Slider lack explicit recording/time semantics
pre_fix_conclusion: VoiceOver cannot reliably operate or understand playback.
required_remediation: Add dynamic play/pause name, scrubber label/value/hint, and grouped time semantics.

evidence: Diff meaning is encoded in green underline and red strikethrough without AX missing/extra semantics
pre_fix_conclusion: VoiceOver cannot distinguish omissions from hallucinations.
required_remediation: Expose structured reference/prediction/missing/extra summaries in the accessibility tree.

evidence: Consent statistics load with try?; failure removes facts but Push remains enabled
pre_fix_conclusion: The user cannot distinguish missing evidence from an empty dataset before upload.
required_remediation: Use explicit summary loading/error and gate submission on reliable record/audio counts.

evidence: Cancel only calls task.cancel; UI retains the old stage and active Cancel until completion
pre_fix_conclusion: The user cannot tell whether cancellation was accepted.
required_remediation: Add Cancelling, disable repeated actions, and check cancellation at external side-effect boundaries.

evidence: Visible dates/durations use hard-coded M/d HH:mm, h/m/s/ms, and String(format:)
pre_fix_conclusion: Supported locales receive mixed units and non-local date conventions.
required_remediation: Use Date/Duration/Measurement format styles and localized interpolation.

evidence: English UI hard-codes 綠/紅; zh-Hant Organization/Repository remain English
pre_fix_conclusion: Both supported languages contain avoidable mixed-language labels.
required_remediation: Use semantic Missing/Extra labels and correct zh-Hant field translations.

evidence: Localized wrappers interpolate hard-coded domain errors or raw HTTP response bodies
pre_fix_conclusion: The most important failure text is technical, mixed-language, and rarely actionable.
required_remediation: Map typed failures to localized user-facing messages and keep raw details in diagnostics.

evidence: Sidebar move transition always animates
pre_fix_conclusion: The record browser ignores Reduce Motion.
required_remediation: Disable movement/animation or use an immediate/fade change under Reduce Motion.

evidence: Whitespace-only repo names enable Push and are trimmed only after submission
pre_fix_conclusion: A preventable invalid network request is allowed.
required_remediation: Validate trimmed values and Hugging Face naming rules inline before enabling Push.
